info.title: Get Marketplace Creator Performance
info.description: Get the Creator Affiliate's Marketplace information and performance metrics in the last 30 days.

get.description: Get the Creator Affiliate's Marketplace information and performance metrics in the last 30 days.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: data_groups
parameters.description:
Creator's Data Group, get all group by default, which include: 
- BASIC_CREATOR_INFORMATION
- CONTENT_PERFORMANCE
- FOLLOWER_INFORMATION
- COLLABORATION
- SALES_AND_GMV

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

url.description: The URL for the creator's TikTok profile avatar.

avatar.description: Metadata and data associated with the creator's TikTok profile avatar.

selection_region.description: The region associated with the creator.

bio_description.description: The biography description associated with the creator.

profile_tt_uri.description: The URL for the creator's TikTok profile page.

brand_collaboration_count.description: The total number of brands with which the creator has previously collaborated.

units_sold.description: The total number of units sold. Units are indexed to SKU. Note that if the creator has not given permission for precise data sharing, this property will not be present.

minimum_amount.description: The lowest number of units sold.

maximum_amount.description: The highest number of units sold.

formatted_range.description: The formatted range of minimum number of units sold to maximum number of units sold over the lifetime of the creator account.

units_sold_range.description: The range of minimum number of units sold to maximum number of units sold over the lifetime of the creator account. ec_live_count.description: The number of e-commerce livestreams associated with the creator.

ec_video_count.description: The number of e-commerce video posts associated with the creator.

avg_ec_video_play_count.description: The average number of number of e-commerce video plays.

avg_commission_rate.description: The average commission rate in hundredths of a percent. Note that if the creator has not given permission for precise data sharing, these properties will not be present.

maximum_amount.description: The largest average commission rate in hundredths of a percent.

avg_ec_live_view_count.description: Average live stream views with promoted products.

key.description: The location, use [TWO-LETTER STATE AND TERRITORY ABBREVIATIONS](https://www.faa.gov/air_traffic/publications/atpubs/cnt_html/appendix_a.html)

pps.description:
Promotion Performance Score (PPS)
The score reflects the quality of a creator's shoppable content and product selection over the past 90 days. A high score may indicate a better shopping experience, with fewer potential refunds or negative reviews.

rating.description: Rating from sellers who worked with this creator

ec_video_engagement_rate.description:
The number of post engagements (likes, shares, and comments) divided by the total video views averaged across the videos in the last 30 days.
For example, 3000 stands for 0.3 or 30%

post_rate.description:
The projected rate at which a creator is likely to post a shoppable video or LIVE after receiving a sample.
For example, 3000 stands for 0.3 or 30%

is_official_recommend.description: Creaor has official recommend tag or not

video_play_cnt_30d_med.description: Creator average VIDEO play count last 30 days

live_view_cnt_30d_med.description: Creator average LIVE view count last 30 days

live_like_cnt_30d.description: Creator LIVE like count last 30 days

live_comment_cnt_30d_med.description: Creator average LIVE comment count last 30 days

live_share_cnt_30d_med.description: Creator average LIVE share count last 30 days

video_publish_cnt_30d_med.description: Creator average VIDEO publish count last 30 days

is_eligible_flat_fee.description: Creator is eligible for flat fee invitation

is_rising_star.description: Creator has rising star tag or not

creator_fulfillment_score_90d.description: Creator fulfillment score during last 90 days

sample_score.description: Creator credit total score. e.g. 75 means creator' sample scole is 75/100.

engagement_rate.description: Trend engagement rate e.g. 558 means creator's engagement rate is 5.58%

creator_profile.description: Advanced creator profile infomation. If we return an empty object, it means this filter is not currently supported by your account or region.

creator.description: Data associated with the creator's TikTok profile.
